test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: The following sentence has been split into segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.**

The players were practicing for an hour / when the coach came / and asked them to stop.

options.text: The players were practicing for an hour

solution:
Here, the erroneous part is **"The players were practicing for an hour**."
